note: Everyday questions end to end with every model down (D108). tuning must stay 100 percent. heldout (10) and heldout2 (12) are SEEN: each was used, after its first run, to write more routing patterns, so they only guard against regression (heldout 5 of 10 before any change, then 10 of 10; heldout2 9 of 12 after the first broadening, then 12 of 12 after a second round). heldout3 (12) was written before the second round and run once after it: 7 of 12 (misses: 'how's my health looking?', 'am I at a good weight', 'how much should I be weighing', 'how am I tracking against my goals', 'am I eating and sleeping okay'). That 7 of 12 is the honest estimate for unseen wordings: keyword phrases route about 6 in 10 of them; the rest fall to the general route and still get a safe, released answer, but not the progress one. heldout3 is now seen too; the next honest number needs a fresh set or a different method (a model-assisted closed-set classifier was considered and deliberately not built the day before the real deployment).
